articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin stuck near $65,000 as popular 'basis trade' returns dry up
articles.description: XRP edged toward $1 and SOL rose 3%, while a Talos report showed crypto’s favorite carry trade now pays about what Treasuries do.

articles.title: U.S. judge says Ethereum has ‘no terms of use,’ clears MIT brothers of $25 million fraud
articles.description: A federal judge acquitted Anton and James Peraire-Bueno, ruling that their 2023 trade against Ethereum trading bots involved no lie that anyone relied on, and closing the U.S. government’s first criminal case over the practice known as MEV.

articles.title: Bitcoin's 12% slide through key support looks scary, but history says give it 3 months.
articles.description: Bitcoin broke below its 200-week average with a 12% drop. Only three similar crashes have occurred since 2013. Here’s what happened next.

articles.title: XRP whales moved $270 million during the selloff. The coins didn’t go to exchanges
articles.description: A holder whose wallets trace back to a 2020 Bitstamp withdrawal has moved 281 million XRP into two vaults three weeks apart, a behavior indicative of custody rather than a large investor heading for the exit.

articles.title: CFTC nominee questions public benefit of prediction markets as legal fight grows
articles.description: One of the two picks to join the regulatory commission, Democratic nominee Matthew Rowland, said he hopes to have a say in prediction markets rulemaking.

articles.title: Nvidia shares rise on earnings beat, raised outlook despite leadership uncertainty
articles.description: Speaking on the earnings call, Chairman Harvey Jones said the board has no intention of reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO.

articles.title: Coinbase CEO says AI agents will account for '99.9%' of transactions within a decade
articles.description: Brian Armstrong says Coinbase is building payment tools for AI agents and believes bitcoin has hit bottom despite the selloff.

articles.title: Predictions platform Kalshi complies with order to halt Trump mention contracts
articles.description: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission ordered it to stop "mention" contracts involving the U.S. president and is reviewing whether Kalshi followed policy.

articles.title: Druckenmiller says he is short copper, warns of economic weakness in 2027
articles.description: The billionaire investor is prioritizing capital preservation and shifting his AI focus from infrastructure to applications.

articles.title: U.S. Fed Governor Waller pitches keeping central bank at the center of tokenization
articles.description: Waller suggested the Federal Reserve could provide trusted rails for emerging innovation tied to tokenized assets and agentic AI.

articles.title: Hong Kong, Swift test tokenized deposits as banks chase stablecoin-style speed
articles.description: Hong Kong and Swift expanded their efforts to connect tokenized bank deposits across currencies, building on earlier work involving digital central bank money.

articles.title: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade risks breaking up to 15,000 automated apps
articles.description: In addition to that broader estimate, independent audits have uncovered hundreds of separate compatibility problems, with core developers set to reconsider the changes Thursday.

articles.title: Decentralized exchange Grvt looks to makes commodity trading more predictable with stable funding perps
articles.description: Grvt’s new Stable Funding Perps tie the cost of holding commodities trades to traditional-market financing costs, rather than volatile crypto-style funding.

articles.description: Your day-ahead look for Nov. 17, 2026

articles.description: The fund swapped its common stock in Bloom Energy, Nebius and SanDisk for call options, keeping its bet on AI power, computing and memory.

articles.title: Bitcoin remains penned in near $64,000 even as ETF outflow streak ends
articles.description: Bitcoin (BTC) is down a further 1.0% since midnight UTC at around $64,200, with its bounce from the weekend selloff stalled and pressure building on all fronts.

articles.title: Solana Foundation takes majority stake in crypto data provider CoinGecko
articles.description: The foundation plans Solana-powered trading on CoinGecko's website, GeckoTerminal and app.

articles.title: New DeFi-yield generation targets ‘scam-like’ bank accounts that keep all the interest

articles.title: Fed Governor Michael Barr warns AI agents could trigger bank runs in minutes
articles.description: In a speech at an AI event in Italy, Barr said automated financial decisions could overwhelm banks and raises concerns about AI systems bypassing security controls.

articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin and stocks continue slump as Huang signals interest in returning to Nvidia
articles.description: The Fed's hawkish rhetoric continued on Tuesday, with St. Louis Fed President Musalem arguing for several rate hikes before next spring. Homebuilder confidence fell to a 14-year low.

articles.title: Hackers plant crypto-stealing code on 178 major websites, including HSBC and Ledger
articles.description: An Optimizely signup flaw let an attacker plant address-swapping code on websites including HSBC, the BBC and Ledger. The total stolen remains unknown, and investigators have not linked the attack to AI.

articles.title: Nvidia faces first earnings test without Jensen Huang as AI stocks slide
articles.description: With shares almost 40% below their October peak, Nvidia’s guidance could carry more weight than quarterly results as investors assess its direction without Jensen Huang.

articles.title: Binance hacker moves $63 million in stolen ether after 2 weeks of silence
articles.description: North Korea's TraderTraitor group transferred 34,279 ETH to three new wallets. The funds have not moved again, blockchain investigators say.

articles.title: Bitcoin could slide into the $50,000s as Fed rate hike bets build, Wintermute says
articles.description: Bitcoin may slide into the $50,000s after losing its 200-week average, with ETF outflows, weak demand and rate-hike risks weighing on BTC, leading market maker warns.

articles.title: Cardano Foundation seeks $5 million from treasury using ADA price 33% above market
articles.description: The Foundation wants 25 million ADA for 12 global events, even as the token trades well below the 20 cent price used to size the request.
